title: WebhookEnvelope
description:
Fields common to every Etsy webhook delivery, per the Etsy webhooks
documentation. Per-event payloads differ but all include these three
top-level fields.

resource_url.description:
A prepared Open API v3 URL the subscriber can call back to
retrieve the updated resource referenced by the event.

shop_id.description: Identifier of the Etsy shop related to the event.
